chunks: So be not like those who became disunited and differed among themselves after clear proofs had come to them. For them is great suffering.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who disunite after receiving clear proofs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the early Ummah's fragmentation after the Prophet's death, serving as a critique of sectarian division (tafarruq) that occurred despite the clarity of the Quran and Sunnah. It underscores the necessity of adhering to the Ahl al-Bayt as the preserved path to avoid the 'great punishment' reserved for those who dispute the truth after it has been made manifest.
